dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL (OpenCOBOL) free-format source, part of the Applewood Computers Accounting System (ACAS) by Vincent B Coen. Uses >>source free directive, C$JUSTIFY intrinsic, and references to OpenCOBOL v3.00.00 migration.

purpose.domain_detail: Sales ledger invoice print module for the Applewood Computers Accounting System (ACAS). Handles printing invoices to printer and/or sending them via email to customers.
purpose.summary: This program (sl930) is the invoice print module of the ACAS sales ledger system. It reads sales, delivery, and invoice files and produces printed invoices on stationery or plain paper, optionally also generating email files for customers who have email invoicing enabled. It supports multiple copies, company heading customisation, VAT details, and email client integration via mailx.

notable_features: Email file generation and mailx integration (zz090-Issue-Email)
COPY copybooks for environment, file select, and print spool commands
Support for both printed and emailed invoices simultaneously
WS-Sleep variable for email client timing
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
GNU GPL licensed open-source accounting system
verdict.notes: Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full program is 1485 lines. The program is clearly production-quality with extensive change history, copyright notices, and real business logic. Dialect is GnuCOBOL free-format. No COMP-3 usage detected despite financial domain, which is unusual but consistent with GnuCOBOL usage patterns in this codebase.
